# Bibi Sipra, CPA

> Big 4 (EY) trained US CPA and Senior Tax Manager. US corporate tax compliance and reporting for Fortune 500, multinational and pre-IPO companies: ASC 740 income tax provision, SEC reporting, international tax provision, US federal and multistate compliance. Open to US and Asia-Pacific (APAC) corporate tax roles — full-time, contingent or fractional; onsite or remote.

Canonical profile: https://www.bibisipra.com/
Full resume (expanded experience, FAQ, availability): https://www.bibisipra.com/resume/ — Markdown version: https://www.bibisipra.com/resume.md — PDF: https://www.bibisipra.com/bibi-sipra-cpa-resume.pdf
Contact / CV requests: https://www.bibisipra.com/#contact (Direct Contact form; messages go directly to Bibi)

## Summary
- Name: Bibi Sipra, CPA
- Headline: Big 4 Senior Tax Manager — US Tax Compliance & Reporting
- Based in: Tampa Bay, Florida, United States
- Open to: Senior Tax Manager, Tax Director, US Tax Accounting Lead / ASC 740 Provision Lead, and regional tax roles with significant US tax responsibility
- Target locations: United States (Tampa Bay onsite, or remote anywhere in the US); Singapore; Kuala Lumpur, Penang and Petaling Jaya, Malaysia; Bangkok, Thailand; Jakarta and Bali, Indonesia; Hong Kong
- Engagement types: full-time, contingent, fractional; onsite or remote

## Availability and relocation
- Current status: engaged on a special-projects contract through November 2026, with limited capacity for part-time or advisory work before then.
- Next full availability: December 2026 for contract, fractional, interim or full-time roles; conversations for the Q1 2027 provision season are open now.
- Relocation: open to relocating within Asia-Pacific (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Hong Kong) for the right role; Florida CPA license is active.
- Remote: based in the US Eastern time zone (UTC-5/-4); works remotely for US clients nationwide and can cover US-side work for an APAC regional tax team.
- Engagement vehicles: W-2 contract via Korn Ferry, MBO Partners or a client's preferred vendor; 1099 independent contractor; direct full-time hire.

## For Asia-Pacific employers
- Fit: US-qualified tax leadership for a regional tax team in Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Jakarta or Hong Kong — the US side of a US-parented or US-listed group's Asia-Pacific operations.
- US international tax from the US-parent perspective: foreign tax credit and Form 1118, Section 904 loss accounts, GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI (formerly FDII), BEAT, Forms 5471, 5472 and 8858.
- ASC 740 for SEC registrants and IFRS (IAS 12) for foreign-parented groups; PCAOB audit support.
- Asia-Pacific jurisdiction experience: Australian corporate income tax (MEC group, CFC attributable income, debt deduction creation rules).
- OECD Pillar Two (GloBE, IIR, UTPR, QDMTT): working awareness.

## Experience
- Independent corporate tax consultant, March 2023–present: contract, fractional and interim Senior Tax Manager engagements with Big 4 firms and multinational companies (via Korn Ferry and MBO Partners). Every contract engagement to date has ended with a full-time offer.
- Senior Tax Manager, US International and Australian Tax (contract), April 2025–present: private equity-owned global drilling services company (~US$1B revenue) — IFRS provision through a go-private year, Form 1118 foreign tax credit model, Section 904 OFL/ODL/SLL reconstruction, BEAT (Form 8991), Section 863(b) sourcing, Australian corporate income tax return (CFC attributable income) and a first-year debt deduction creation rules (DDCR) model.
- Senior Tax Manager, Multistate Compliance (recurring seasonal contract), Deloitte Multistate Tax, July 2024–present: led two teams (11 and 8 professionals) filing 495+ multistate corporate returns in ONESOURCE Income Tax for $12B–$50B companies; $6M look-back state tax savings.
- Senior Tax Manager, Tax Provision (fractional), January–April 2024: insourced a multinational sports media company's ASC 740 provision from a Big 4 firm, cutting advisory spend 80% with no audit findings.
- EY, 2016–2023: Tax Staff through Tax Senior and Tax Manager to Tax Senior Manager, Global Compliance and Reporting; public, private and PE-backed multinational clients up to ~$45B revenue; ASC 740 audit lead for SEC filers, a pre-IPO S-1 and a PE carve-out; global purchase accounting for an acquisition by a $37B public distributor.
- Full detail: https://www.bibisipra.com/resume/
- Credentials: Certified Public Accountant (CPA). MBA (summa cum laude) and undergraduate studies in business management and accounting, University of South Florida.

## Areas of expertise
- SEC reporting with global exposure: managing cross-border teams and collaborating with foreign offices on complex global engagements; complex multinational structures.
- ASC 740 and international tax provision: preparing and reviewing income tax provisions for multinational companies across multiple jurisdictions; valuation allowance analysis; deferred tax scheduling; consolidating foreign entity data.
- US federal, APAC, multistate and cross-border compliance: thousands of corporate tax returns in ONESOURCE Income Tax; coordinating filings for complex overseas legal structures; multi-jurisdictional compliance across the US, APAC, EMEA and LATAM.
- Tax law change: advised on TCJA, CARES Act and Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) changes for multinational entities; current on evolving US, Asian and Oceania rules.
- Project management and collaboration: led cross-functional teams bridging tax, legal, treasury and external advisors.
